properties.Name: LoanInterestRate

Columns.Name: LoanId
Columns.Description: The unique identifier of a Product.

Columns.Name: MinimumAccountBalance
Columns.Description: The minimum account balance for which the associated base rate is applicable.

Columns.Name: MaximumAccountBalance
Columns.Description: The maximum account balance for which the associated base rate is applicable.

Columns.Name: InterestRatePeriodStartTimestamp
Columns.Description: The period start timestamp for which the associated interest rate is applicable.

Columns.Name: InterestRatePeriodEndTimestamp
Columns.Description: The period end timestamp for which the associated interest rate is applicable.

Columns.Name: InterestRatePercentage
Columns.Description: The loan interest rate expressed as a percentage for fixed rate. The rate added to the index for variable rate.

Columns.Name: AnnualPercentageRate
Columns.Description:
Annual Percentage Rate. A way of expressing the cost of credit on a loan. Under federal law, all consumer loans must disclose the Annual Percentage Rate.

Often confused with interest rate, an APR supplies the cost of credit over the course of a year. It is supplied as a percentage taking into consideration the amount finance, any charges, and the term of the loan.

Columns.Name: AnnualPercentageYield
Columns.Description: The APY based on the interest rate percentage.

Columns.Name: LoanInterestRateTypeId
Columns.Description: The unique identifier of a Loan Interest Rate Type.

Columns.Name: MarginInterestRateAdjustmentPercentage
Columns.Description:
A percentage that is added /subtracted from the associated interest rate of the interest rate type.

The rate is adjusted in increments, called the margin, to compensate for greater credit risk or other factors that affect the cost of lending.

Columns.Name: InterestRateNote
Columns.Description: A note, comment or additional information regarding the interest rate.

Columns.Name: InterestRateIndexId
Columns.Description: The unique identifier of an Interest Rate Index.

Columns.Name: AprBasisTypeId
Columns.Description: The unique identifier of an APR Basis Type.

Columns.Name: BillingCycleId
Columns.Description: The unique identifier of a Billing Cycle.

The interest rate(s) used to calculate charges for the associated product for the associated period.

A product may have multiple interest rates that are applicable depending on the purpose of the interest.
